messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm seeing a handful of KB pages in staging hitting 403s because they still point to old S3 shortlinks (example: https://s3.redwood.internal/short/abc123). Can someone grab a quick sweep? I'm on a customer call for the next 90m.

maria: A few affected paths I found so far (staging):
- /kb/runtime/caching
- /kb/onboarding/quickstart
- /runbook/storage-s3
(there may be more in localized copies)

omar: I can take /kb/runtime/caching. Will open a PR to replace the shortlinks with canonical CDN URLs and add frontmatter redirects. ETA today.

tayler: Helpful grep to find them locally: `rg -n "s3.redwood.internal/short/" content/ | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u` — that'll give you the file list including translated directories.

maria: Nice, thanks. Omar, when you patch can you also add a `redirect_from` frontmatter entry so our site redirect middleware picks it up? Docs link-checker will re-run after CI.

docs-bot: Automated message: link-checker found 8 instances in staging across 6 files; tracking ticket created: DOC-3123.

hannah: I can handle /kb/onboarding/quickstart and push fixes for EN + JA once Omar and I coordinate canonical URLs.

omar: PR #4578 opened: replaces shortlinks, adds `redirect_from` and a short changelog note. @jess could you do a quick CR when you have a moment?

jess: On my list — should be able to review in ~30m. Quick ask: can we include a short line in the PR description about translation impact so i18n knows to re-run snapshots?

maria: :thumbsup: Perfect. After merge, can someone run `./scripts/link-health-scan.sh --staging` (or trigger the staged job) to confirm fixes?

tayler: I'll run the scan post-merge and paste results here.

maria: Thanks everyone — ping me if any of the files require a deeper rehost (we might need to re-upload assets to CDN instead of linking).
